title: Mitochondrial might: powering the peripartum for risk and resilience.
authors: Gorman-Sandler E, Wood G, Cloude N, Frambes N, Brennen H, Robertson B, Hollis F.
figures: Many of the physiological processes that occur in the peripartum rely on mitochondria. Mitochondria house the rate-limiting enzymes responsible for the synthesis of steroid hormones that fluctuate across the peripartum, including gonadal hormones, glucocorticoids, and neurosteroids, such as allopregnanolone.
